title: Chat Summaries, Re-Run Actions, LaTeX
description: Conductor 0.34.2 changelog - Chat Summaries, Re-Run Actions, LaTeX
summary: We’ve added chat summaries. Hover the table of contents to see a brief overview of your chat. Failed GitHub Actions checks now have a re-run button, so you can retry them without leaving Conductor.
html:
We’ve added chat summaries. Hover the table of contents to see a brief overview of your chat.

Failed GitHub Actions checks now have a re-run button, so you can retry them without leaving Conductor.

We’ve also added support for LaTeX.

Improvements

  • Diagrams now use Conductor's theme colors for better visual consistency
  • Smoother experience opening files in IDEs like Cursor and VS Code
  • Repo name is now included when searching for workspaces with /add-dir
  • PR title is now shown in the sidebar in experimental mode
  • "Workspaces" label changed to "History" in experimental mode

Fixes

  • Fix autoscroll not working correctly
  • Fix image attachments not rendering properly
  • Fix garbled escape codes in terminal on buffer replay
  • Fix settings sidebar spacing not matching workspace sidebar
  • Fix chat scrolling performance by removing a redundant cache subscriber
markdown:
We’ve added chat summaries. Hover the table of contents to see a brief overview of your chat.
![image](/assets/changelog/media/0.34.2/1770749325599-image.png)
Failed GitHub Actions checks now have a re-run button, so you can retry them without leaving Conductor.
![image](/assets/changelog/media/0.34.2/1770749325912-image.png)

We’ve also added support for LaTeX.
![image](/assets/changelog/media/0.34.2/1770749326150-image.png)

## Improvements

- Diagrams now use Conductor's theme colors for better visual consistency
- Smoother experience opening files in IDEs like Cursor and VS Code
- Repo name is now included when searching for workspaces with /add-dir
- PR title is now shown in the sidebar in experimental mode
- "Workspaces" label changed to "History" in experimental mode

## Fixes

- Fix autoscroll not working correctly
- Fix image attachments not rendering properly
- Fix garbled escape codes in terminal on buffer replay
- Fix settings sidebar spacing not matching workspace sidebar
- Fix chat scrolling performance by removing a redundant cache subscriber
